svg.title: Depthly project form — Create and Edit proposals
svg.desc: Two refined modal proposals with project-name guidance, a live appearance preview, larger labeled color and line-icon choices, and a clear save action. Existing fields only: name, color, icon.
svg.text: A clearer home for your work
Project form proposal · the same familiar fields, with clearer guidance and a live preview.
Group related tasks under one clear name.
Name the outcome, client, or course you’re working on.
You can add tasks after creating your project.
A project keeps related tasks and focus time together.
Update the name and appearance of this project.
Name the outcome, client, or course you’re working on.
Your existing tasks and sessions stay connected.
Changes are saved only when you choose “Save changes”.
44px selection targets · visible selected states · descriptive color and icon names
Design preview · shared Create/Edit layout · proposed line icons replace emoji
